additional_info.subject: Linz AG Modbus Sicharge D
additional_info.body:
Hello
Our customer Linz AG installed an ELMS system on site and has problems with the modbus communication.
He is using a Beckhoff Controller and is currently only able to read and write the Power Limit. He says, that all other registers are not reachable.
He would need to read AC and DC current but also voltage.
Additionally, the customer said, that an AC Error was read from the controller. I am not sure, what kind of error this should be, as the charger does not have an AC socket.
Charger ID:
VoIiSz
Can you please help us there
BR Nenad

additional_info.subject: Handover Note from L2 to ES
additional_info.body:
Problem Description: I
nstalled an ELMS system on site and has problems with the modbus communication.
Suspected root cause :
NA
Reason of Handover (L3) :
need deeper analysis
Action Performed (L2) : Logs analysis
Charger SW Version:
v5.0.21-0-g33832fc
Fault history:
N/A
Log analysis with timestamp: 04/12/2024, 07:07:32hrs
Note-
The customer can read registers 15, 16, 18, 42, and 47, but all other registers are returning zero. There is an issue with Control Word 1 where Bit01 is incorrectly set to TRUE.
The customer reported that they cannot read the actual voltage and current, and an AC Error Word Bit 00 is true, despite the charger not having an AC socket configured.
